PLAINTIFF'S NOTICE OF WAIVER OF ORAL ARGUMENT AS TO HIS MOTION
FOR TARGETED VACATUR OF ECF NOS. 64 AND 84
Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine gives notice under Local Civil Rule 7(J) that he waives oral
argument on Plaintiff's Motion for Targeted Vacatur of ECF Nos. 64 and 84, Withdrawal or
Modification of the Magistrate-Judge Referral, and Related Interim Relief, submitted concurrently
with this Notice, including the request for interim relief contained in that Motion, and requests that
the Court determine those matters on the papers under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 78(b).
Plaintiff has not obtained the agreement of counsel for Defendants to a hearing date or to
submission on the papers under Local Civil Rule 7(E). Plaintiff requests that the Court direct the
manner of submission, whether on the papers or at a hearing on a date the Court sets, and Plaintiff
will comply with that direction. Plaintiff requests determination upon completion of the briefing
permitted by Local Civil Rule 7(F)(1), or sooner if the Court so directs.
1

This waiver is limited to the Motion and interim application identified above. It does not
waive Plaintiff's pending request to restore oral argument on ECF Nos. 15 and 54 (ECF No. 67 1
6(d)). It does not withdraw or modify any objection, request, or issue presented in ECF Nos. 66, 67,
68, or 76. It does not alter the Notice of Waiver of Oral Argument as to ECF Nos. 66, 67, and 76
submitted on October 12, 2026, or the notices of waiver submitted concurrently with the Rule 72(a)
objections to ECF No. 84 and with the disqualification motion.
Date: October 13, 2026
Respectfully submitted,
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se
1520 Belle View Blvd, Ste. #5847
Alexandria, Virginia 22307
(407) 794-6503
jayballentine@protonmail.com
2

CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE
I hereby certify that on October 13, 2026, I submitted the foregoing Plaintiff's Notice of
Waiver of Oral Argument as to His Motion for Targeted Vacatur of ECF Nos. 64 and 84, together
with the accompanying Certification Pursuant to Local Civil Rule 83.1(N) and Generative
Artificial Intelligence Disclosure and Citation Certification, to the Clerk of Court for filing through
the Court's Electronic Document Submission System (EDSS).
I further certify that, upon the Clerk's docketing of the submission on the Court's Case
Management/Electronic Case Filing (CM/ECF) system, a Notice of Electronic Filing will be
transmitted to counsel of record for Defendants National Center for Missing & Exploited Children,
Katie Hall, and Meta Platforms, Inc., who are registered users of that system and will be served
through that means.
Date: October 13, 2026
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se
3

Disclosure and Citation Certification accompanying the Notice; and (4) this Certification Pursuant
to Local Civil Rule 83.1(N). This certification applies to each and every document identified
above.
